what: A coordinator overrode its own git identity to make a commit land, and the hosting service refused the resulting push over an email-privacy setting, requiring several commits to be redone.
rule: Never override git identity; the repository's own configuration decides.
fix: Enforcement: shipping now refuses, before any push, when a commit in the change carries an author or committer email that is neither the repository's configured address nor a hosting-service-issued privacy address. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-n.test.mjs`.
